findings.detail: The source states a 20.00% fixed coupon, not a floating-rate basis spread; any extracted basis_spread of 20.00 is coupon text mapped into the spread field.

rationale: Class 2 within-row terms issue. The source row for Retail & Animal Intermediate describes the instrument as '20.00 %, Fixed Coupon, all PIK' rather than as a reference rate plus spread.
